headline: Bowa's 12th-inning single walks off the Expos
recap: Larry Bowa's single with one out scored Orlando Gonzalez from third in the bottom of the 12th, lifting the Phillies past the Montreal Expos 3-2 at Veterans Stadium. Gonzalez, pinch-hitting for reliever Ron Reed, led off the inning with a single; Bake McBride reached on a fielding error and Bud Harrelson's sacrifice bunt moved both runners into scoring position before Bowa delivered.

Gary Carter had supplied all of Montreal's offense with solo home runs in the second and fifth innings, his 19th and 20th of the season, both off Phillies starter Randy Lerch. Lerch worked eight innings and allowed only those two runs; Expos starter Dan Schatzeder matched him, throwing eight innings of his own before the bullpens took over.

Philadelphia had already erased the 2-0 deficit in the bottom of the ninth, tying it at 2-2 with nobody out on Greg Luzinski's error-aided single and Mike Schmidt's triple. The Phillies loaded the bases twice more that inning but stranded the go-ahead run when pinch-hitter Tim McCarver's at-bat ended with Bake McBride picked off first. Ron Reed threw three scoreless innings of relief to earn the win before Gonzalez's pinch-hit single opened the 12th.
